summary: Iteration 88 - MAARS Infinity Phase 5 (Operator Control & Test Harness) fully tested. All 24 backend tests pass. All frontend features verified: Operator Control Panel with 4 tabs (Overview, Approvals, Test Harness, Autonomy), scenario execution, test results display, and MAARS Infinity sidebar navigation including Operator Panel link. Existing pages (observability, model-router, commander, venture-portfolio) still work.

backend_test_harness_scenarios_api.details: GET /api/infinity/test-harness/scenarios returns 5 scenarios (A-E) with correct names and descriptions

backend_run_scenario_a.details: POST /api/infinity/test-harness/run/A - Research Goal Pipeline executes correctly, returns steps with pass/fail status

backend_run_scenario_c.details: POST /api/infinity/test-harness/run/C - Memory & Learning Loop executes correctly

backend_run_scenario_d.details: POST /api/infinity/test-harness/run/D - Intelligence Search with real DuckDuckGo executes correctly

backend_run_all_scenarios.details: POST /api/infinity/test-harness/run-all runs all 5 scenarios and returns combined results with suite summary

backend_test_history.details: GET /api/infinity/test-harness/history returns historical runs with filtering and limit support

backend_operator_dashboard.details: GET /api/infinity/operator/dashboard returns unified data: system_health, pending_approvals, incidents, escalations, circuit_breakers, budget_summary, agent_workload, tiers

frontend_operator_panel_loads.details: Operator Control Panel at /operator loads correctly with page title and system health badge

frontend_overview_tab.details: Overview tab shows stat cards (Pending Approvals, Open Incidents, Open Escalations, Circuit Breakers) and Open Incidents list

frontend_approvals_tab.details: Approvals tab shows pending approvals with Approve/Deny buttons (data-testid pattern: approve-{task_id}, deny-{task_id})

frontend_test_harness_tab.details: Test Harness tab shows 5 scenario cards (A-E) with play buttons and Run All Scenarios button

frontend_test_results_display.details: After running scenario A, test results card appears with step-by-step pass/fail details and Recent Test Runs history

frontend_autonomy_tab.details: Autonomy tab shows 5 autonomy tiers (T0-T4) with name, max_spend, approval requirements, and allowed actions. Agent Workload by Network grid visible

frontend_sidebar_operator_panel.details: MAARS Infinity sidebar section includes Operator Panel link (data-testid='nav-operator-panel')

critical_code_review_comments: All Phase 5 APIs have real implementations (no mocks)
Test Harness scenarios run actual system tests (Scenario D uses real DuckDuckGo search)
Operator Dashboard aggregates data from multiple services efficiently
Frontend uses proper data-testid attributes on all interactive elements
Tab navigation works correctly with state management via useState
seed_data_creation: Test Harness runs create entries in test_harness_runs collection (cleaned up via scenario prefixes)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 88 tested Phase 5 (Operator Control & Test Harness). Test Harness has 5 scenarios: A (Research Goal Pipeline), B (Verification Pipeline), C (Memory & Learning Loop), D (Intelligence Search with real DuckDuckGo), E (Budget & Governance). Operator Dashboard at /api/infinity/operator/dashboard provides unified view. Frontend Operator Control Panel at /operator has 4 tabs controlled by data-testid='tab-{overview|approvals|harness|autonomy}'. All scenarios can be run via play buttons or Run All Scenarios button. Results appear in data-testid='test-results'.
